Exactly ONE compact object toolbar from y44 to y92: small muted "FUC-128", title "成员邀请与权限", an amber dot and "待决策", right a quiet "关联成果 6", ellipsis. Do NOT add breadcrumbs, description block, tabs, KPI cards or second toolbar beneath this.
Core content begins near y108. Broad main area left ~74%, a restrained right context column ~26%, divided by a single very light vertical rule. Reading measure is intentional, not stretched.
In the broad main area, present a beautifully typeset chronological CASE RECORD, a fine vertical timeline inset 28px, small event icons and aligned 12px times. There are four curated events with varied content rhythm:
"09:12 需求已确认" — "管理员可邀请成员，并控制加入后的项目角色。" Below, quiet linked source "需求说明 v2" and a tiny "林悦 · 已确认".
"09:36 边界已对齐" — one compact line "项目拥有成员关系；邀请不改变设备与连接器权限。" Source chip "boundary.md v1".
"10:18 新的架构取舍" — this is the visually focused current entry, a subtle warm-neutral vertical highlight not a nested card. Title 18px "邀请链接应如何失效？" Under it, two compact alternative rows, "A  服务端保存邀请记录" and "B  仅使用签名令牌". A short reason "需支持撤销、过期与重复接受，且每次操作校验项目权限。" Single black primary button "进入决策室  →". Small amber "ADR-012 · 等待负责人".
"下一步" — small grey outlined node, "完成决定后，返回详细设计。" Not a fake progress percentage.
No chat bubbles. Do not spread the ten ADD activities across the page.

Right context column title "本次判断的依据" with aligned editorial rows and subtle file icons: "邀请需求.md  v2", "特性边界.md  v1", "项目权限设计  已采用". Below a small compact section "影响范围": "服务端邀请接口", "成员加入流程", "验收标准 AC-03 / AC-04". Then "协作": two miniature avatars and "Lead · Codex", "负责人 · 林悦". At the bottom an unobtrusive link "查看完整案卷". This support column is simple grouped content, not many cards.
Visual style: polished editorial product design, crisp white and graphite hierarchy, delicate 1px grey rules, compact file links, tightly calibrated spacing, a small number of muted semantic amber/green indicators. Sophisticated composition with life from typography and event rhythm, not decoration. Preserve the shell exactly and its icon shapes as closely as possible.
Avoid: large page titles, huge empty blocks, nested cards, charts, gradients, colourful sidebar, marketing copy, floating app mockup, device bezel, 3D tilt, multiple screens, app brand replacement, stacked tabs, ten-column Kanban.

artifacts.title: ADR 决策室
artifacts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE production-quality desktop software screenshot for Fouc, the DECISION CASEBOOK concept, ADR decision room. The attached image is only the actual Fouc SHELL REFERENCE; retain its real shell and replace its dashboard content.
A flat screenshot around 1600×1000, not a mockup presentation. Ultra-precise NORMAL 100% desktop density, comparable to a mature desktop engineering tool. Do not enlarge typography or components to fill the frame. Global sidebar boundary x=264px (only about 16.7% of the frame); top system toolbar 44px. 13px UI body, 12px metadata, 18px heading, 30px buttons, regular data rows 36px. Sparse content should leave space, never grow its type. The generous content area is achieved by width, not giant components.
Match reference shell: project picker "Fouc 桌面端 V1", grey #f9f9f9; sidebar labels "新对话", "工作台", "任务", "成员", "资产", "智能体", channel "频道" / "产品与设计", "最近", bottom "社区", "连接器", account "Fouc Admin", theme/settings. Workbench selected. Solid grey icon language. Top history, active small "ADR-012" tab, plus, search, task and window controls. White main surface 16px exterior corner radius, delicate perimeter line. No new branding.
Design within this shell:
EXACTLY one 44px object toolbar at y44–88, title inline "ADR-012" / "邀请链接失效机制" (18px) / tiny amber "待决定". Right quiet "成员邀请与权限" link and ellipsis. No hero title beneath it, no breadcrumbs, no tabs, no KPI rows.
Main content from y104 is a refined architectural decision comparison, broad left 71% and right decision column 29%, single thin vertical divider.
Left: tiny "依据" label followed on the same line by file links "需求说明 v2" and "特性边界 v1". Then an exceptionally polished comparison TABLE, no cards. Columns: "约束", "A 服务端邀请记录", "B 仅签名令牌". Header A has a tiny "建议采用" info label. Five tight rows:
"主动撤销" | "更新记录即可撤销" | "需要额外失效名单"
"过期与重发" | "状态可追踪，旧链接失效" | "令牌到期前仍可使用"
"重复接受" | "事务内返回已有结果" | "需额外幂等记录"
"项目权限" | "每次请求校验真实主体" | "同样需要服务端校验"
"实现代价" | "一份权威记录" | "最终仍需额外状态"
The typography is small and crisp, 36–44px data rows. Very light grey header, one thin line per row, no strong grid cage.
Below at y430, compact editorial section "推荐理由" with 2 readable short paragraphs, each about two lines at 13px: "本需求需要撤销、重发和审计，邀请具有持续状态。服务端记录让失效与重复接受在同一权威来源内处理。" and "签名令牌仍可用于链接校验，但不能代替项目成员授权。"
At y570, a small two-column impact region with thin dividers, "采用后需更新" listing "详细设计：邀请状态与接口" and "测试计划：撤销、过期与重复接受"; "保持的边界" listing "邀请不授予设备执行权限" and "项目权限由每次真实操作校验". No icons made from emoji.
Right column: heading "记录本次决定" 16px. A compact selection row/radio "采用方案 A", checked. Label "决定说明" and an editable 3-line text area containing "邀请状态以服务端记录为准，令牌只承担链接验证。". Small owner row "负责人 林悦", source row "基于需求 v2 / 边界 v1". At y480, thin separator, "确认后" / "回到特性详细设计，并更新受影响的引用。". Bottom quiet supporting link "保留为待定".
One black primary 30px button "确认采用方案 A" at the lower end of this column around y660; secondary "继续讨论". This is an ADR human decision, DO NOT label it G2 or G5.
Professional editorial tone: subtle rules, clean whitespace, neat baseline rhythm, restrained neutral surfaces, tiny semantic amber/green/blue use. Useful real product content dated 2026-11-12. The casebook concept must read as a decision tool, not a chat app.
Avoid huge text, giant row heights, floating cards, huge blank header, a toolbar enclosed inside another card, nested tabs, ten stages across the screen, coloured app branding, generic dashboard, marketing poster, multiple screens.

artifacts.title: 交付与资料整理
artifacts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset: ONE realistic production desktop app screenshot, Fouc ADD DECISION CASEBOOK concept, page "交付与整理".
Input image is the actual Fouc application shell reference. Reuse the exact shell design and replace dashboard content only. Flat full app screenshot approx 1600×1000, normal desktop 100% density. Sidebar about 264px / 17% frame, system bar44px. Small 13px UI/body,12px metadata,18px headings,30px buttons,36px evidence rows. NEVER enlarge sparse content to fill the screen. Crisp professional product design.
Shell exactly matches reference: project "Fouc 桌面端 V1"; grey #f9f9f9 sidebar with neutral solid icons and "新对话", "工作台", "任务", "成员", "资产", "智能体", "频道", "产品与设计", "最近"; lower "社区", "连接器", "Fouc Admin", theme/settings. Workbench selected. System bar back/forward, active compact "交付与整理" tab, plus, search/task/window buttons. White main workspace with16px outer corners.
Exactly one compact object/action row below system bar, y44–88: muted "FUC-128", inline title "成员邀请与权限 · 交付与整理" at18px; tiny amber "待回写资料"; right quiet "查看案卷" and ellipsis. No extra giant page title, tabs, KPI cards, stacked properties or breadcrumbs. Real work begins at y104.
Composition differs from a document editor or ADR comparison: main left ~58% is a linked verification report; right ~42% is a concrete documentation update preview, separated by one subtle vertical rule. Polished, refined editorial continuity with light chronological connectors.
Left heading small16px "交付证据". Immediately show three compact chronological rows, icons small:
"11:08  已合入主分支" / tiny "G5 · 林悦确认" / source link "merge-128".
"11:26  预发布环境验证通过" / source "E2E-09 · 2026-11-12".
"11:42  正式发布已批准" / tiny "负责人 林悦" / source "release-0.1.0".
These are source-linked sample events, no giant summary cards. G5 means MERGE CONFIRMATION ONLY, distinct from E2E and release approval.
At y300 small heading "已验证的用户旅程", a tasteful compact horizontal four-step sequence with fine connectors and small green tick nodes: "发送邀请" → "打开链接" → "确认加入" → "检查角色". Under it one line "预发布环境 · 独立端到端验证 · 查看原始记录".
Below an elegant grouped evidence TABLE, columns "验收项", "结果", "证据". Four ordinary36px rows:
"正常接受邀请" | "通过" | "E2E-09 / 01"
"撤销后链接失效" | "通过" | "E2E-09 / 02"
"重复接受返回已有结果" | "通过" | "E2E-09 / 03"
"无权限用户被拒绝" | "通过" | "E2E-09 / 04"
Small semantic green result dots, not pill overload. At y620 small source links "独立评审 R2" and "批次评审已通过". Below a small calm note "证据绑定本次版本；后续变更需重新核对。"
Right: small16px heading "回写权威资料", metadata "2 项修改建议 · 尚未写入". Two compact file rows:
"design.md" with selected light grey state and small "更新"; "rules/project-access.md" with "补充".
Below show a serious readable before/after text-diff preview of selected design.md, not a decorative code block. File name once, miniature hunk label "邀请的失效与重复接受". Red-tinted deleted line "- 邀请链接的有效性由令牌到期控制。"; three green-tinted added lines "+ 以服务端邀请记录决定是否有效。", "+ 撤销或重发立即使旧链接失效。", "+ 重复接受返回已存在的成员关系。". Normal 13px mono or mixed Chinese text, subtle red/green backgrounds and clear gutters. This is illustrative proposal content, not actual repository diff.
Below a compact reason paragraph "将本轮已确认的决定吸收进原设计；案卷保留讨论与证据引用。" Then two quiet source references "采用 ADR-012" and "基于 E2E-09". At y740 one30px black primary button "确认回写并完成" and neutral secondary "稍后整理".
Do not add a knowledge base, new global menu, stage progress bar or a second project selector. All resource context remains current project. One page only, not montage.
Visual feel: precise white/graphite product, delicate1px grey rules, generous but calibrated spacing, strong baseline grid, refined tiny source links, semantic colours only. No large components, no card-inside-card, no marketing decoration, no gradient, no phone or device frame, no poster.

validation_notes: Three independent full application pages; no montage.
Shell grounded in the actual Fouc screenshot; all illustrated outcomes and identifiers are mock content.
Root inspected all three pages; first-page collaborator labels were simplified to Codex and Lin Yue and visually checked.
